title: Protocol to generate fast-dissociating recombinant antibody fragments for multiplexed super-resolution microscopy
protocol: Extract the total mRNA from antibody-producing cells using TRIzol Reagent.
Reverse-transcribe 0.5 μg of mRNA to synthesize cDNA using ReverTra Ace qPCR RT Master Mix kit.
Amplify the antibody cDNA by PCR with ExTaq polymerase.
Subclone the antibody cDNA into pMD20 Vector.
Obtain the antibody sequence using M13 Fw and Rv primer.
Align the sequencing result using IgBlast tool and ANARCI web.
Insert the antibody Fv cDNAs into the expression vectors using NotI and BamHI sites.
Transfect HEK293T cells with the expression vector of recombinant antibodies.
Grow HEK293T cells to be 80% confluent in two 10 cm petri dishes for the production of one antibody.
Dilute 30 μL Lipofectamine 3000 Reagent in 1.5 mL Opti-MEM and vortex for 2–3 seconds.
Dilute 30 μg of DNA in 1.5 mL Opti-MEM separately.
Add 30 μL P3000 Reagent to the diluted DNA and mix well.
Combine the solution with a DNA-lipid complex (∼3 mL) and mix gently.
Incubate for 10 min at 15°C–25°C.
Add 1.5 mL of the DNA-lipid complex to each 10 cm dish containing 10 mL culture medium.
Harvest the supernatant of transfected cells 3–4 days after transfection.
Centrifuge the culture supernatant at 200×g for 3 min to remove cell debris.
Prepare Ni-NTA agarose beads by washing them three times with 1 mL TBS.
Suspend Ni-NTA resin in stock buffer and transfer an appropriate amount of resin to a 1.5 mL tube (50 μL per antibody).
Add 1 mL TBS buffer to the suspended Ni-NTA resin.
Centrifuge at 500 × g, 4°C for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant carefully without aspirating the beads.
Equilibrate the Ni-NTA beads by adding 5 bead volumes of TBS.
Adjust the pH of harvested culture supernatant to 8.0 using 1 M Tris-HCl (pH 8.0) at a volume ratio of 1%.
Add 150 μL of equilibrated Ni-NTA beads to each 15 mL tube containing culture supernatant.
Incubate with gentle rotation at 4°C for 2 hours.
Wash the beads twice with TBS and once with TBS containing 10 mM imidazole.
Elute the recombinant antibodies with 200 μL of 200 mM imidazole diluted in TBS buffer (pH 7.5) for 3 minutes on ice.
Centrifuge at 500 × g, 4°C for 5 minutes to separate supernatant from beads.
Collect 180 μL of the supernatant for dialysis.
Dialyze the purified antibodies with 1 L TBS using a 6–8 kDa Spectra/Por membrane at 4°C for 20 hours, exchanging buffer once after 4 hours.
Transfect XTC cells with antigens using the Neon transfection system protocol.
Culture transfected XTC cells in 22°C incubators for approximately 24 hours.
Subculture into a 25 cm² flask if cells are used after more than 24 hours.
Coat coverslip with 0.1 mg/mL PLL at 4°C for 16 hours.
Trypsinize the transfected XTC cells and resuspend in L-15 (+) buffer.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 3 minutes.
Remove supernatant and resuspend cells using L-15 (-) buffer.
Seed cells on PLL-coated coverslips in 6-well plates. Use a cell number of 2 × 10⁴ per Φ24 mm coverslip.
Rinse coverslips at least 6 times with distilled deionized water before seeding cells.
Culture cells in an incubator at 22°C for 1 hour.
Fix cells using a 3.7% PFA buffer in Cytoskeleton buffer at 15°C–25°C for 20 minutes.
Add 0.5% Tx-100 to remove the cytoplasmic fraction of antigens if necessary.
Wash cells three times with PBS.
Permeabilize cells using PBS containing 0.2% Tx-100 (v/v).
Block samples for 1 hour at 15°C–25°C using 3% BSA in PBS buffer.
Wash samples three times with PBS before imaging.
Acquire single-molecule time-lapse images of bound antibodies in transfected cells.
Dilute recombinant antibodies to a concentration between 0.1 and 0.5 nM in imaging buffer.
Determine the density of single-molecule speckles using antibody probes.
Ensure target proteins are sparsely labeled, typically with 0.1–0.5 speckles/μm².
Adjust the concentration of fluorescent antibodies to achieve the desired speckle density.
Find a transfected cell expressing H2B-mCherry.
Switch to the GFP channel.
Check if the density of speckles in the cell is suitable for single-molecule imaging.
Acquire time-lapse image series of bound single-molecules in the cell.
Use Total Internal Reflection Fluorescence (TIRF) illumination to reduce background signals.
Ensure acquisition speed of time-lapse imaging matches with antibody kinetics.
Track the single-molecule using software such as tanitracer.
Use tanipoc.py in Tanitrancer to correct stage drift during acquisition using BF images.
Calculate the dissociation rate (koff) using a one-phase-decay model.
Output the regression of speckles detected in the first frame using tanitime.py in Tanitracer.
Copy the “Lifetime” and “Regression” column to GraphPad Prism 9.
Analyze the data using “Nonlinear Regression” > “one-phase-decay”.
Express EGFP-actin in XTC cells.
Fix the cells with 3.7% PFA buffer containing 0.2% Tx-100.
Wash the cells three times with PBS buffer.
Acquire time-lapse images for EGFP regression.
Design the forward and reverse primer for the reaction.
Introduce the point mutation by PCR reaction.
Digest methylated plasmid template with DpnI (New England Biolabs, R0176S) for 90 min.
Transform the mutated plasmid into competent E. coli DH5α.
Purify the antibody mutants.
Measure the dissociation rates using the procedures described.
Combine two point mutations in VH and VL to further increase the dissociation rate.
Introduce an additional H/Nb27G, H/Nb28A or H/Nb102A substitution to further increase the dissociation rate with a high probability.
